package.description: In-memory data structure store, used as database, cache and message broker

en-US.description: In-memory data structure store, used as database, cache and message broker
en-US.longDescription: Redis is an open source, BSD licensed, advanced key-value cache and store. It is often referred to as a data structure server since keys can contain strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, bitmaps and hyperloglogs. This is a Windows port maintained by Microsoft Archive
en-US.name: Redis on Windows
